items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: this is the Gibson band you're talking about... first it was Sonny Williams

ctx.x: I wonder about, uh, the different people in the band. What did you think of them as individuals? If you don't mind answering them.

No, I don't mind. Uh, well, as regards, uh, this is the Gibson band you're talking about. Yeah, the Gibson band. Yes. Uh, I was, I was impressed with, uh, Eddie Richardson to start with. Uh, he's the leader. I think he behaves as though he is. Yeah, he's the musical director. He's the, yes, that, uh, I, I would say he would be, by far the best musician. Uh, the trombonist, Carol Blunt, uh, also impressed. I don't know how he'd be in a jazz band, but he certainly did know how to drive it down in a, in a marching…
